args.command:
cd /bench/repo && for t in Attachment IdentityProvider Inbox InstanceSetting Memo MemoRelation MemoShare Reaction User UserIdentity UserSetting; do
  files=$(grep -rl --include="*.go" -E "store\.${t}\b" . | grep -v "^./store/" | grep -v "_test.go")
  pkgs=$(echo "$files" | grep -v '^$' | xargs -r -n1 dirname | sort -u)
  n=$(echo "$pkgs" | grep -c . )
  occ=$(grep -rho --include="*.go" -E "store\.${t}\b" . 2>/dev/null | wc -l)
  echo "=== $t : pkgs=$n"
  echo "$pkgs" | sed 's/^/    /'
done

message.text: Confirmed the counts: user's data shows 7 packages and 93 references, while my memory shows 6 packages (or 7 including family/fileserver) with 64 references. Time to write up the answer.

h11.

**1st: `store.User` (7 packages, ~93 references); 2nd: `store.Memo` (6 packages, ~64 references)**

The data layer is the `store` package at `/bench/repo/store`, where the persistent entity types are declared: `User` (`store/user.go:29`), `Memo` (`store/memo.go:35`), `Attachment` (`store/attachment.go:16`), `Inbox` (`store/inbox.go:24`), `MemoShare` (`store/memo_share.go:6`), `MemoRelation` (`store/memo_relation.go:16`), `Reaction` (`store/reaction.go:7`), `IdentityProvider` (`store/idp.go:12`), `InstanceSetting` (`store/instance_setting.go:14`), `UserIdentity` (`store/user_identity.go:8`), and `UserSetting` (`store/user_setting.go:13`).

Counting distinct Go packages outside `store/` (which includes the driver implementations in `store/db/...`) that mention each type:

| Type | Packages | References |
|---|---|---|
| `User` | 7 | ~93 |
| `Memo` | 6 | ~64 |
| `Attachment` | 4 | ~40 |
| `Inbox` / `MemoShare` | 3 | ~14 / ~10 |

`store.User` appears in `server/router/api/v1`, `server/router/api/v1/test`, `server/router/fileserver`, `server/router/rss`, `server/router/frontend`, `server/auth`, and `server/notification`. `store.Memo` appears in the same set except `server/auth` and `server/router/fileserver`, plus `server/runner/memopayload`.

Two notes on how I scoped this. If you also count the companion query/mutation structs (`FindUser`, `UpdateMemo`, and so on), `User` and `Memo` tie at 7 packages each, since `server/router/fileserver` uses `store.FindMemo` even though it never names `store.Memo` directly — `User` still leads on raw reference volume. Also, `proto/gen/store` shows up in naive text searches for names like `store.IdentityProvider` and `store.UserSetting`, but those are protobuf descriptor string literals such as `memos.store.UserSetting` inside generated files, not references to the data-layer types, so I excluded them.
